leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement semantic HTML elements within Vue components to improve screen reader navigation
Configure ARIA attributes on interactive Vue elements to communicate state and purpose
Construct keyboard-navigable interfaces by binding Vue event handlers to appropriate keys
Apply proper focus management techniques using Vue refs and lifecycle hooks
Integrate accessible form validation with Vue's reactive data and computed properties
Manipulate dynamic content announcements using Vue's reactivity system and ARIA live regions
Initialize accessible component patterns by combining Vue slots with semantic markup
